Frequently asked questions

Deposits, payouts and referrals on 12x12.

Can I deposit from an exchange?

Yes. Choose a supported coin and network, then use the exact amount and address from the wallet quote. Allow for exchange transfer fees.

Do I need to connect a wallet?

Send the quoted crypto from an exchange or wallet and submit the transaction hash. Enter your own receiving address when requesting a withdrawal.

When do daily credits start?

The plan starts when you confirm an investment from your approved USD wallet balance. New plans credit your wallet at the activation time of day, starting on the next eligible UTC weekday. Weekends and observed U.S. federal holidays are skipped. Skipped dates extend the term so you receive the stated number of credits. Plan 1 credits 12% daily for 12 paydays, Plan 2 credits 15% daily for 15 paydays, and Plan 3 credits 20% daily for 20 paydays.

How do withdrawals and the daily cap work?

Request crypto withdrawals in Wallet. All USD wallet withdrawal requests share one daily allowance. Unclaimed wallet amounts carry forward.

The plan terms determine how principal is returned and how the daily allowance is calculated.

What if I sent the wrong amount or lost the hash?

Open Profile to see the request details. Contact the cashier with the request ID and any transaction hash you have.

Where do the payouts come from?

Scheduled credits increase your internal USD wallet balance. The cashier sends approved withdrawals from the operator’s crypto wallet. The scheduled credits do not verify that the operator has funds available to settle a withdrawal.

How do referrals work?

After activation, share your referral link from the Referrals page. The referrer earns 12% of the investor’s first investment when it is confirmed. Each active referred plan credits 1% of its invested amount on the same schedule as the plan for the full term. Plan 2 requires five distinct funded direct referrals and Plan 3 requires ten.
